emails_transactionnels_entite_coherence_.name: emails_transactionnels_entite_coherence_check
emails_transactionnels_entite_coherence_.value:
("emails_transactionnels"."entite_type" = 'reservation' AND "emails_transactionnels"."type" LIKE 'reservation_%')
        OR ("emails_transactionnels"."entite_type" = 'demande' AND "emails_transactionnels"."type" LIKE 'demande_%')
        OR ("emails_transactionnels"."entite_type" = 'message' AND "emails_transactionnels"."type" LIKE 'message_%')

emails_transactionnels_erreur_code_check.name: emails_transactionnels_erreur_code_check
emails_transactionnels_erreur_code_check.value:
"emails_transactionnels"."erreur_code" IS NULL OR (
        char_length("emails_transactionnels"."erreur_code") BETWEEN 1 AND 64
        AND "emails_transactionnels"."erreur_code" ~ '^[A-Z0-9_]+$'
      )

generations_ia_a_purger_idx.name: generations_ia_a_purger_idx
generations_ia_a_purger_idx.where: "generations_ia"."entree" IS NOT NULL OR "generations_ia"."sortie" IS NOT NULL

progressions_inscription_validation_chec.name: progressions_inscription_validation_check
progressions_inscription_validation_chec.value:
"progressions_inscription"."proposition_validee_le" IS NULL
        OR ("progressions_inscription"."accroche" IS NOT NULL AND "progressions_inscription"."presentation" IS NOT NULL AND "progressions_inscription"."services_proposes" IS NOT NULL)

services_prix_tarif_check.name: services_prix_tarif_check
services_prix_tarif_check.value: ("services"."tarif" = 'payant') = ("services"."prix_montant" IS NOT NULL AND "services"."prix_devise" IS NOT NULL)
